dedupe_keys.name: sie haiti systeme d information environnementale indicators dashboard and webgis

description: SIE-Haïti is Haiti's environmental information system, a portal of indicators, a dashboard and WebGIS tools for environmental reporting. The home page read on 2026-09-28 organises indicators into categories for land, sea, coast, water, biodiversity, hazards, health and engagement, links them to Haiti's reporting under the UN conventions on desertification, biological diversity and climate change, and lets users open the data catalogue for each category or go directly to the indicator WebGIS, with a tutorial and a login for contributors. Coverage is national. Access is free in the browser; no licence or download terms are stated on the home page. Caveats: indicator vintages and the content of the hazards layers were not opened, and the portal depends on project funding for updates. It supports hazard and land-cover context for exposure studies of Haitian roads, water points and settlements. Related record: data-haiti-health-facilities-paho gives health facility locations that can be overlaid on the hazard layers.
